SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No L. O. D. 94......
Date............15.3.29

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
Central Station,
March 14, 1929.

RE MOLESTATION OF JAPANESE WOMEN ON THE STREETS

Sir,

Acting under your instructions I made inquiries in connection with the alleged cases of molestation of Japanese women in the streets reported by the Shanghai Nippo, dated March 12. My inquiries elicited the fact that the victim in the case occurring in the Pao Loh Li off North Ssechuen Road was Mrs. Matsumura, wife of Mr. T. Matsumura residing at Y.C. 106 Darroch Road. This incident happened at 10.30 a.m. March 5 when Mrs. Matsumura was molested by several Chinese loafers who deprived her of her glasses. The report published in the Shanghai Nippo in this connection is correct, but this case was not formally reported to the station.

With regard to the case of snatching of a muffler, however, there is no truth in this report. The reporter who is responsible for this article, when interviewed by me, stated that he overheard a conversation between two students of the Japanese Girls' High School respecting this attempted larceny, but was unable to guarantee its authenticity. This conversation evidently referred to a case occurring some months ago in which one of the girl students had a narrow escape at the hands of several Chinese footpads who attempted to snatch away her muffler. The reporter apparently published this as an entirely new report by drawing upon his imaginations.

I remain, Sir,
Yours obediently,
S. Nakagawa

Superintendent,
"A" Division.

（左侧手写批注：）
By order
Supt. C.I.D.
15/3

刑事侦缉处登记簿
编号 L. O. D. 94......
日期............1929年3月15日

（刑事侦缉处）办公室备忘录
中央捕房，
1929年3月14日。

关于日本妇女在街头遭受骚扰一事

先生：

遵照您的指示，我就3月12日《上海日报》（Shanghai Nippo）所报道的所谓日本妇女在街头遭受骚扰的案件进行了调查。我的调查查明，在四川北路宝乐里发生的案件中的受害人是松村夫人，即居住在达罗路（Darroch Road）Y.C. 106号的 T. 松村先生的妻子。此事发生于3月5日上午10时30分，当时松村夫人遭到几名中国无业游民的骚扰，眼镜被抢走。《上海日报》就此发表的报道属实，但该案并未正式向捕房报案。

然而，关于抢夺围巾一案，该报道并不属实。负责撰写此文的记者在受我询问时表示，他无意中听到两名日本女子高等中学的学生谈论这起未遂盗窃案，但他无法保证其真实性。这段谈话显然指的是数月前发生的一起案件，当时一名女学生险些遭到几名中国歹徒的毒手，他们试图抢走她的围巾。该记者显然是凭借想象，将此作为一则全新的报道予以刊登。

此致，
敬礼，
S. 中川

警司，
“A”分区。

（左侧手写批注：）
奉命
刑事侦缉处警司
3月15日
中川先生或许可以
将上述情况告知东方股，
并询问他们
是否可以进行调查
3月15日 M.N.

（左下角手写批注：）
批准。
3月15日
R.C.J.

（右下角手写批注：）
知悉
R.C.J.
V J. B. I.
S. 中川先生已通知刑事侦缉处，后者表示他们将警告该记者。R.C.J.

Date............18.3.29

March 12, 1929, Morning Translation.
....................................

MISCELLANEOUS MOLESTATION OF JAPANESE WOMEN IN THE STREET

The Shanghai Nippo publishes the following report:-
Some days ago a certain Japanese lady was subjected to great indignities at the hands of four respectably dressed Chinese in the Pao'loh Li (寶樂里) off North Szechuen Road. As soon as the men saw the lady approaching, one of them, taking advantage of the fact that she was alone, went up to her and attempted to snatch away her glasses. In the ensuing struggle the spectacles dropped and were smashed to pieces. The hooligan then picked up the broken glasses and disappeared. The others simply stood there and laughed as if it were a great joke.
Another Japanese lady residing on Scott Road also had a narrow escape other day on Dixwell Road near North Szechuen Road when three Chinese barred her way and attempted to snatch away her muffler. Fortunately, just then a Japanese gentleman happened to pass by and this frightened away the miscreants. Many Chinese passed by while the helpless 'lady' was struggling desperately, but they did nothing to help her. This sort of molestation of Japanese women frequently occurs nowadays and some are inclined to believe that their motives are other than that of mere larceny.
....................................

-do- BANQUET IN HONOUR OF NEW AND OLD CONSULS-GENERAL

The Shanghai Mainichi, Shanghai Nippo and the Shanghai Nichi Nichi publish the following report:-
Mr. Yada, the former Japanese Consul-General in Shanghai, and Mr. Shigemitsu, his successor, were the guests of honour last night at a large banquet tendered by the leading members of the local Japanese community at the Japanese Club at 6.30 p.m. yesterday. There were present more than 350 persons. The affair was a great success.

D. S. Nakagawa. Shanghai.
Report please. Any truth in
above article?

R. Candlin.
Sgt. 12/3

1929年3月12日，晨间译文。
....................................

日本妇女在街头遭受各种骚扰

《上海日报》刊登如下报道：——
日前，一位日本女士在四川北路宝乐里（寶樂里）遭到四名衣着体面的中国男子的极大侮辱。当这些男子看到该女士走近时，其中一人趁其落单之机，上前试图抢走她的眼镜。在随后的争执中，眼镜掉落并摔得粉碎。那名流氓随即捡起破碎的眼镜后消失不见。其他人则只是站在那里大笑，仿佛这是一件极大的趣事。
另一位居住在斯科特路（Scott Road）的日本女士，日前在四川北路附近的狄思威路（Dixwell Road）也险些遇险，当时三名中国人拦住她的去路，试图抢走她的围巾。幸运的是，恰在此时一位日本绅士路过，吓跑了这些恶棍。在这位无助的女士拼命挣扎时，许多中国人从旁经过，却无人施以援手。如今，此类骚扰日本妇女的事件频繁发生，有些人倾向于认为，其动机不仅仅是单纯的盗窃。
....................................

同上 为新旧总领事举行的宴会

《上海每日新闻》（Shanghai Mainichi）、《上海日报》（Shanghai Nippo）和《上海日日新闻》（Shanghai Nichi Nichi）刊登如下报道：——
前驻上海日本总领事矢田先生及其继任者重光先生，是昨晚6时30分在日本俱乐部由当地日本社区主要成员举办的大型宴会上的主宾。出席人数超过350人。活动取得了巨大成功。

D. S. 中川。上海。
请报告。
上述文章是否有事实依据？

R. 坎德林。
警长 3月12日
